subject: APAC / EU partner compliance & integration checklist
messages:
From: Sakura Systems <partners@sakura-sys.jp>
To: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 22:05:00 +0900
Subject: Interest in Redwood Private for JP + EU deployments

Hi Hiro,

Thanks for the intro at the meetup last week — Sakura Systems runs platform services for two enterprise customers that need low-latency inference in Tokyo and Stuttgart. We liked Redwood’s model routing and the private deployment option. Before we proceed we'd like to confirm a few things so our security/compliance folks can sign off: 

- Can Redwood Private be configured so inference stays inside a customer VPC and never leaves the region (we have strict data residency requirements in EU & JP)?
- Do you offer KMS/HSM integrations (we use AWS KMS and an on-prem HSM option)?
- What audit logs are available (request/response-level metadata, redaction options, retention policies)?
- Typical timeline for an SI-led PoC (Sakura will manage the customer-side infra).

If you can send a short checklist or a partner integration guide we can share with our security team, that would speed things up. Happy to jump on a quick call this week (JST afternoons work best).

Best,
Masako Ito
Partnerships Manager
Sakura Systems
attachments: none
From: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
To: Sakura Systems <partners@sakura-sys.jp>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 09:30:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood Private for JP + EU deployments

Masako — great to hear, and thanks for reaching out. Looping in Karthik (APAC partnerships) and Vanessa (EU partner ops) so we can align on technical and commercial asks. 

I attached a short APAC data-residency checklist that covers the items you listed (KMS, VPC-only deployments, and audit log options). High-level answers here: 

- VPC/private deployment: yes — Redwood Private supports customer-controlled VPC connectors and can be deployed with strict egress rules. We have an on-prem package for fully air-gapped installs.
- KMS/HSM: we integrate with AWS KMS and offer a bring-your-own-HSM mode; we can also support Vault-backed keys for the PoC.
- Audit logs: request metadata, token counts, and per-request latency are captured; we provide configurable retention and can redact model outputs per policy.
- PoC timeline: typical SI-led PoC is 4–8 weeks depending on infra readiness and signatures.

Next steps/asks: 
1) Can you share a contact at the customer for infra scheduling?
2) Please review the attached checklist and the MSA draft (we can iterate).
3) Suggest a 30-min sync — Thu Nov 13 JST 15:00 or Fri Nov 14 JST 11:00?

I attached: apac-data-residency-checklist.xlsx and redwood-partner-msa-draft.pdf.

Cheers,
Hiro Tanaka
Head of APAC Partnerships
Redwood Inference
attachments: apac-data-residency-checklist.xlsx, redwood-partner-msa-draft.pdf

Folks — forwarding Sakura's initial note and Hiro's replies. Quick internal notes / proposal: 

- Recommend engaging NordSec Consulting as the SI in EU (they have a Stuttgart office and prior experience with our private installs). I'll ping them to confirm capacity and rates.
- For Japan, propose we route the PoC to our Tokyo partner cluster and use a managed KMS in-region. Sakura asked for an on-prem HSM option — we should confirm whether the customer expects Redwood to manage the HSM or if they will provide it.
- Commercial: if the customer is open to a reserved capacity trial we can surface a reduced rate for the PoC week. Need Sergio to OK the credit.

Action items: 
- Vanessa: can you draft a short MAP (mutual action plan) with milestones for signatures, infra setup, and PoC acceptance criteria?
- Sergio: can you confirm whether we can offer up to 1 week of reserved capacity credits for PoC under partner deals?

-karthik
From: Sakura Systems <partners@sakura-sys.jp>

Hi Hiro,

Thanks for the quick responses. Putting in a few clarifications from our security team and looping in NordSec (their EU compliance lead will handle the Stuttgart side):

- Data residency: customer expects inference inputs and outputs to remain in-region. They are ok with control-plane telemetry being aggregated centrally if it contains no PII.
- KMS/HSM: customer will provide an HSM appliance for Stuttgart; Sakura will coordinate the on-prem HSM install. For Tokyo we'd prefer AWS KMS.
- Audit + retention: they want 90-day retention for request metadata and the ability to purge per-tenant logs on request.

NordSec: are you able to run the private runtime inside the customer's Stuttgart data center (we can provide rack space)? Also please confirm your previous Redwood installs.

Attached: po-meeting-agenda.docx (agenda for the PoC kickoff)

Regards,
Masako Ito
Sakura Systems

Hi Masako / NordSec team — thanks for the clarifications. Drafting a compact mutual action plan below (timeline assumes signatures within 5 business days):

Mutual Action Plan (draft):
- Day 0–3: Execute MSA + SOW (we will push redlines on Clause 7 and Appendix B). DocuSign link will be shared.
- Week 1: Infra prep — NordSec validates Stuttgart rack & HSM connectivity; Sakura validates Tokyo VPC and KMS access.
- Week 2–3: Private runtime deploy (NordSec + Sakura) and smoke tests.
- Week 3–4: PoC validation with 3 sample inference flows, performance and residency checks.
- Week 5: Acceptance review and roll decision.

Open items for signature: 
- MSA redlines: we can accept the primary commercial terms but need explicit SLA carveouts for data residency breaches.
- Audit retention: 90 days for metadata, per-tenant purge within 7 business days — confirmed.
- Credits: Sergio, can we offer 1 week reserved capacity credit for the PoC?

I’ve attached the MSA draft (redwood-partner-msa-draft.pdf) and the PoC agenda. Please review and I’ll send the DocuSign envelope once legal signs off on two small edits.

Best,
